package.description: Live interview copilot overlay that answers questions in real time and stays invisible in screen shares.

en-US.description: Live interview copilot overlay that answers questions in real time and stays invisible in screen shares.
en-US.longDescription: Mbason Copilot is a desktop overlay for live interviews. It listens to the interview, answers questions in real time grounded in your resume, and is excluded from Zoom, Teams, and Meet screen shares at the OS level. Requires a Mbason AI account.
en-US.name: Mbason Copilot
